prompt: Aerial drone photo of Seoraksan National Park in Korea at peak autumn, the Cheonbuldong valley with jagged granite peaks and slopes covered in red, orange and yellow maple foliage. A colossal 300 meter tall tornado made entirely of swirling autumn leaves rises from the valley floor, a spinning column of red and gold leaves twisting up above the peaks, leaves streaming off its top into the blue sky, the trees below stripped bare in a spiral path, tiny hikers on a rock ledge and a suspension bridge looking up, clear crisp afternoon light. Negative: dust, debris, smoke, storm clouds, rain
